tasksTab.whyQueuedTitle: Why can a task stay queued?
tasksTab.whyQueuedIntro: The queue does auto-fill freed slots, but “max concurrent tasks” is an upper bound, not a guarantee that all tasks can start immediately.
tasksTab.reasonConcurrency: A task can only continue when a concurrency slot becomes free.
tasksTab.reasonGpuVram: Even with a free slot, the scheduler still needs an available GPU and enough free VRAM.
tasksTab.reasonSharedQueue: Training jobs, inference jobs, and AI Chat Page PDF high-quality GPU parsing all share the same GPU queue.
tasksTab.reasonCancellation: Cancelled tasks release resources asynchronously; once resources are actually released, later tasks are retried automatically.
tasksTab.reasonRecovery: After a restart or power loss, queued training tasks that were persisted in the database are automatically re-queued; transient AI Chat Page PDF parsing jobs are not persisted and must be retriggered by a new request.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Notice
privacyPolicy.fullTitle: PathLab Privacy Notice and Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introText: This notice explains, at a high level, how we handle personal data in connection with PathLab. In Hong Kong, relevant handling of personal data may be subject to <lawCap486>the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486)</lawCap486>. It should be read together with the Terms of Service, medical notices, and any feature-specific prompts or notices shown in the product.
privacyPolicy.importantText: Where a feature-specific notice, consent prompt, or institutional deployment notice states different details, the more specific notice governs that processing to the extent of the inconsistency.

s1.title: 1. Scope and roles
items: 1.1 This Privacy Notice and Privacy Policy describes how SmartLab may collect, use, store, disclose, or otherwise process personal data in connection with account access to and use of the Services.

1.2 It covers data relating to account registration and login, agreement acceptance, maintenance notices, datasets, annotations, permissions, tasks, results, AI features, and support or feedback interactions.

1.3 If you use the Services on behalf of an institution, that institution may separately determine the purposes and means of handling source datasets and patient or research data that it uploads or manages through the Services.

s2.title: 2. Categories of data we may handle
items: 2.1 Account and profile data, such as username, nickname, role, avatar, and related account identifiers.

2.2 Authentication and security data, such as login timestamps, agreement acceptance records, notice acknowledgment records, IP addresses submitted or detected during login or acceptance, and anti-abuse verification results where enabled.
2.3 Device, browser, client, and local storage data, such as application version, browser type, operating environment, local cache state, and similar troubleshooting information.
2.4 Service operation data, such as dataset metadata, file-path registration details, annotations, permissions, task records, reports, outputs, and audit or error logs.
2.5 Feature inputs, such as prompts, uploaded documents, parsed PDF content, search queries, voice audio, transcripts, and feedback that you choose to submit through enabled features.

s3.title: 3. Purposes of processing
items: 3.1 To provide, authenticate, secure, maintain, and support the Services and related user accounts.
3.2 To operate requested features, including AI assistance, document parsing, speech transcription, search, task orchestration, visualization, and reporting.
3.3 To enforce permissions, investigate misuse, detect abuse, troubleshoot incidents, improve reliability, and comply with legal, regulatory, or institutional requirements.

s4.title: 4. Data sources and your responsibilities
items: 4.1 We may receive personal data from you directly, from your organization or administrator, from your device or browser, or from integrations and service providers used to operate the Services.
4.2 You are responsible for ensuring that any patient, research, employee, or third-party data you upload, connect, or submit is lawfully collected, lawfully shared, and de-identified where required.
4.3 Local browser storage, desktop storage, or PWA caches may retain copies of certain data on your device. You are responsible for managing local access on shared machines.

s5.title: 5. Disclosure, processors, and cross-border handling
items: 5.1 We may disclose or make data available to service providers and processors that support authentication, bot protection, public IP lookup, AI model APIs, speech recognition, web search, PDF parsing, hosting, infrastructure, storage, security, and similar operations.

5.2 Authorized administrators or institutional personnel may access relevant records where necessary for account administration, security response, auditing, permissions management, or legal compliance.

5.3 If you use external-provider features, relevant data may be processed outside Hong Kong or outside your institution's environment, subject to that provider's terms and policies. You remain responsible for determining whether that use is appropriate under your own compliance obligations and, where applicable, <lawCap486>the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486)</lawCap486>.

s6.title: 6. Retention and security
items: 6.1 We seek not to retain personal data for longer than is reasonably necessary for the disclosed purposes, subject to legal obligations, dispute handling, security needs, and legitimate operational requirements.
6.2 We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal data, including access controls and security monitoring where appropriate.
6.3 No internet or local computing environment is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security or uninterrupted availability.

s7.title: 7. Access, correction, and contact
items: 7.1 Subject to applicable law, including where applicable <lawCap486>the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486)</lawCap486>, you may request access to and correction of personal data we hold about you.
7.2 Requests and privacy-related enquiries may be sent to the contact address stated in this notice.
7.3 You may also manage or remove local device copies, browser storage, and cached data under your control.

s8.title: 8. Changes to this notice
items: 8.1 We may update this Privacy Notice and Privacy Policy from time to time for legal, operational, security, or product reasons.
8.2 Where appropriate, we will provide notice through the product, by email, or by requiring renewed acceptance before continued use of some or all Services.
